item.title: Transportation Department says more than 550 driving schools must close over safety failures
item.description: More than 550 commercial driving schools in the U.S. that train truckers and bus drivers must close after investigators found they employed unqualified instructors, failed to adequately test students and had other safety issues, the federal Transportation Department announced Wednesday. The move marks the Trump administration's latest effort to improve safety in the trucking industry. [...]
